Content: “What do we mean by the Revolution? The war? That was no part of the Revolution; it was only an effect and consequence of it. The Revolution was in the minds of the people, and this was effected from `text(1760)` to `text(1775)`, in the course of `text(fifteen years)`, before a drop of blood was shed at Lexington.”
